meta.title: An unknown status value is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the status set to “selected”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Insufficient parameters”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed).

plan.title: An unknown status value is refused

assert.say: the event's title is not the one step 1 sent (nothing changed)
